As you may recall, I've been entertaining the idea of adding megathreads for talking about stuff related to anything and getting to know one another. At the time, the only way we could get together and talk to one another was the music room, but not everybody's gonna want to go out of their way to do that. At the time, there wasn't a way to just drop in here and talk about some otherworldly work of fiction from your childhood, or one that you just stumbled upon and you wanna tell everybody about it because it's great.

Introducing, conversation threads.

These threads will help the regular posters, like @SilverBanana, @xbryn, and myself, to get to know each other and they will help passive lurkers get out of their shell and talk about things that inspire imagination. Posting pictures, music, etc. can be exhausting to certain people because it requires them to track down the artist and provide a link to their website, which not everybody is efficient at. These threads enable the more casual audience to get involved. Stumble upon an artist that you love? Wanna talk about a game you either played in the past or just found out about? Wanna geek out about some incredible music you found?

As long as it's related to Dreamworlds, smash that "Discuss" button and have at it. Sometimes, the most mysterious thing you can explore is another human mind.
